data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: asset-studio
service.description: Structured-data-driven production of marketing images and videos with identity consistency and render provenance

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o asset-studio-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

ai-gateway.description: Every image and video generation call. Model policy, routing, and capacity stay in the gateway; this scenario speaks no vendor protocol and holds no vendor credential (DECISIONS D-008).
ai-gateway.degraded_behavior: Render jobs queue and report the gateway unavailable rather than failing. Nothing already produced is affected and no direct-to-vendor fallback is attempted.

image-tools.description: Deterministic operations for derived variants, reusable look recipes, and image analysis for conformance scoring. Image processing is not reimplemented here.
image-tools.degraded_behavior: Derived variants are not produced and their absence is reported; the parent asset is still releasable. Automated conformance scoring degrades to operator-only judgement, which is the P0 behaviour regardless.

browser-automation-studio.description: Executes capture specs (ASSET-P1-003). This scenario never drives a browser itself. Disabled until the capture spec kind is built.
browser-automation-studio.degraded_behavior: Capture specs cannot render; generative specs are unaffected.

search-hub.description: Federated retrieval over identity and asset metadata, never bytes (ASSET-P1-008). Disabled until the provider descriptor exists.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: Local library queries keep working; only federated reach is lost.

agent-manager.description: Commissioned spec composition and conformance triage from the workbench (ASSET-P1-011). Disabled until that surface exists.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: The workbench loses the commission action; every manual path is unaffected.

audio-tools.description: Persona voiceover bound to an identity record (ASSET-P2-001). Disabled; the host has no hardware audio sink today.
